notes: All figures transcribed from the Nutrition & Allergen Information table on pandaexpress.com (2026-10-05). Entrees and sides are published as single servings (entree ~5.6-6.7 oz, side 12 oz / Super Greens 10 oz); those serving-size items have no build.

Bowl = 1 side + 1 entree; Plate = 1 side + 2 entrees; Bigger Plate = 1 side + 3 entrees. Panda does not publish combo totals, so combo macros are the sum of the published side and entree servings. A half-and-half side is 0.5 of each side component. A la carte and family-size portions are not published and are omitted.

Items marked regional/limited-time on the site (Chow Fun, Quinoa Fried Rice, Eggplant Tofu, Black Pepper Chicken, SweetFire Chicken Breast, Chicken Potsticker, Hot & Sour Soup) are included as published. Promotional entrees and Panda Crafted Beverages (published only as a range) are omitted; fountain drinks are omitted.
